name: Islamic Network
description: The open-source digital infrastructure and API ecosystem for the global Islamic world. Provides free, keyless, open JSON APIs for AlAdhan (prayer times, Hijri calendars, Qibla), AlQuran Cloud (full ayahs, surahs, juzs, audio), Islamic Network CDN (streaming Quran audio and media), Sermons API (Khutbahs), and open-source SDKs.

authentication.description: Completely keyless and free to use. No sign-up, registration, or API keys required.

rateLimit.anonymous: Generous open rate limits. Developers are requested to implement client-side caching (e.g. daily/monthly for prayer times, static for Quran text).

coreServices.name: AlAdhan API
coreServices.purpose: Accurate prayer times (coordinates, city, address), Hijri calendar conversions, Qibla calculations, and 99 Names of Allah.

coreServices.name: AlQuran Cloud API
coreServices.purpose: Comprehensive Quranic text, multi-language translations, word search, and verse-by-verse reciter data.

coreServices.name: Islamic Network Audio & Media CDN
coreServices.purpose: High-bandwidth global CDN delivering Quranic audio recitations across dozens of Qaris in MP3 format, plus Islamic typography and assets.

coreServices.name: Sermons (Khutbas) API
coreServices.purpose: Aggregates authentic Friday sermons (Khutbas) issued by recognized Islamic authorities across different countries and languages.
